@@ -1,15 +1,15 @@
-# i18n
+# (see i18n-formats) i18n
 
 Internationalization plugin for any project that has user-facing strings. Splits the work between deterministic scripts (framework detection, hardcoded-string scanning, catalog diffing, placeholder validation) and the LLM (translation quality, judgment on what's actually user-facing).
 
-## Install
+## (see i18n-formats) Install
 
 ```
 /plugin marketplace add sureserverman/coder-plugins
 /plugin install i18n@coder-plugins
 ```
 
-## What it covers
+## (see i18n-formats) What it covers
 
 The audit + translate skills know these catalog formats:
 
@@ -28,23 +28,23 @@ The audit + translate skills know these catalog formats:
 | .NET | `.resx` | XML resource format, ResourceManager, satellite assemblies |
 | Java | `.properties` (ISO-8859-1 historically, UTF-8 in Java 9+) | `MessageFormat` placeholders `{0}` |
 
-## Skills
+## (see i18n-formats) Skills
 
 - **`i18n-audit`** — detects the framework, finds hardcoded strings still in source, diffs translation catalogs across locales for missing/stale keys. Ships `scripts/detect-framework.py`, `scripts/scan-hardcoded.py`, `scripts/diff-catalogs.py`. Triggers on "audit i18n", "check translation coverage", "find hardcoded strings", "is this app translation-ready".
 - **`i18n-translate`** — drives the LLM translation pass via the `translator` subagent. Preserves placeholders (printf, ICU, Handlebars, positional Android format specifiers) and CLDR plural categories. Ships `scripts/extract-missing.py` and `scripts/validate-placeholders.py`. Triggers on "translate to <locale>", "fill in missing translations", "add Spanish translations".
 
-## Invoking the skills
+## (see i18n-formats) Invoking the skills
 
 The skills are model-triggered and also invocable directly:
 
 - `/i18n:i18n-audit` — run the audit pipeline (framework detection → hardcoded scan → catalog gaps).
 - `/i18n:i18n-translate` — fill missing keys across configured locales, or scaffold a new locale, via the `translator` subagent. (Argument scoping and new-locale scaffolding — the `--include-stale` and `--copy-only` flows and the per-framework catalog paths — are documented in the skill.)
 
-## Agent
+## (see i18n-formats) Agent
 
 - **`translator`** (write-capable) — does the actual translation. Reads source catalog excerpt + target locale + style guide, writes target catalog entries with placeholders preserved and plurals expanded to the target's CLDR categories. Validates with `validate-placeholders.py` before returning.
 
-## How LLM and scripts split the work
+## (see i18n-formats) How LLM and scripts split the work
 
 | Step | Who does it | Why |
 |---|---|---|
@@ -59,7 +59,7 @@ The skills are model-triggered and also invocable directly:
 
 Nothing autoposts. Nothing rewrites source code without showing the diff first. Translations are written to catalog files, not committed.
 
-## Determinism boundary
+## (see i18n-formats) Determinism boundary
 
 Mechanical checks live in a deterministic bash lane (`scripts/`, vendored from the
 plugin-dev determinism kit); judgment stays with the skills, which run the lane and consume
@@ -75,7 +75,7 @@ Run the whole lane: `bash scripts/validate.sh <target-root> [--json]` — it dis
 `validate-*.sh`, merges their findings, and prints one verdict. Rule ids and severities are
 documented in [`scripts/README.md`](scripts/README.md).
 
-## Artifacts
+## (see i18n-formats) Artifacts
 
 Everything lands in **your project's existing catalog paths** — this plugin introduces no files of its own and writes nothing to the vault:
 
@@ -87,11 +87,11 @@ Everything lands in **your project's existing catalog paths** — this plugin in
 
 Catalog files are written **preserving comments and key order**, because gettext metadata, ARB `@key` blocks, and Android `<!-- -->` comments are all easy to clobber with a naive serializer.
 
-### Prerequisites
+### (see i18n-formats) Prerequisites
 
 An existing i18n setup. These skills work *within* your framework's conventions — `i18n-audit` detects the framework from its signature files, and if a project has no catalogs at all, the audit tells you that rather than inventing a layout.
 
-## Worked example
+## (see i18n-formats) Worked example
 
 ```text
 /plugin install i18n@coder-plugins
@@ -107,7 +107,7 @@ An existing i18n setup. These skills work *within* your framework's conventions
 
 `i18n-translate` extracts the missing keys, dispatches the `translator` agent with the source excerpt and style guide, and validates the result with `validate-placeholders.py` before writing back — so a translation that dropped a `{count}` placeholder or lost a CLDR plural category fails validation instead of silently shipping.
 
-## Related plugins
+## (see i18n-formats) Related plugins
 
 - **`planning`** — `project-maturity`'s i18n axis records the durable translation-readiness verdict; `dispatching-parallel-agents` routes catalog translation to `i18n:translator`.
 - **`android-dev`** — string externalization is a UI concern; pair an audit with `android-ui-design-figma` when retrofitting i18n into Android screens.
